description: Partial processing reports a dynamic block without a label
notes: The README makes dynamic a special block type, but doesn't say whether a malformed dynamic block that partial processing doesn't take is an error. hashicorp/hcl adds a header schema for dynamic blocks, with one label, to every schema it applies (expandBody.extendSchema in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), so the wrong number of labels is reported even in partial processing, which leaves a block of a type it doesn't request alone.
reference_error: All dynamic blocks must have 1 labels
